2. Daily Summary
I visited the Grand West Crossing Buildings 3 & 4 job site in Katy, TX. The job site just started, so there was not much to document. Only two YSD workers were on site, and they do not have aerial lifts yet because they are waiting for the project manager to arrive. I got the crew a generator and a 50 ft extension cord, and both workers took the generator inside the job site. Both workers were documented wearing hard hats and high-visibility clothing.
